en.summary: Chongqing is working to develop itself as an international consumption center city by leveraging its distinctive characteristics to attract consumer spending over a five-year period.

en.summary: Hainan is building a rule-of-law business environment to support the full-island closure and operations of its free trade port, with officials emphasizing the need to upgrade business conditions alongside expanded opening-up.

en.summary: Shanghai held an exchange conference on rare disease public welfare care and innovative development, with officials outlining efforts to complete the full industrial chain from research and development through clinical application and manufacturing.

en.title: Shandong Dongying: Former Barren Saline Land Now Year-Round Rural Tourism Area
en.summary: A former salt-alkali wasteland in Dongying has been transformed into a rural tourism destination featuring rice paddy art and attractions. The scenic 34-meter observation tower offers views across the agricultural landscape drawing steady visitor numbers.

Discussions focused on disaster management education, talent cultivation, and industry-education integration approaches.

en.title: Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli Expelled from Party and Military for Serious Violations
en.summary: The Central Military Commission investigated Central Political Bureau member and Vice Chairman Zhang Youxia, and military official Liu Zhenli for serious disciplinary violations. Both were expelled from the Communist Party and military following investigation and Central Political Bureau approval.

The company's strong brand recognition and technological advantages should help it withstand competition from rival battery manufacturers.

en.title: Once the world's most-visited city, Hong Kong now converts hotels into student dorms
en.summary: Hong Kong hotels are being converted into student accommodation as tourism demand declines. A 598-room hotel in Kwun Tong was recently acquired by Nanyang Commercial Bank and is being offered for tender, with potential conversion to dormitory use.
